name: Koimomo
source: Kazuki's parents often traveled abroad, so he was raised most of the time with the Tokizawas, distant relatives of his. There he was raised like a son along with Hazuki, the Tokizawa's daughter. However, his peaceful life is about to be shattered when, while he's staying with the Tokizawas during his parents' long business trip, a mysterious girl called Momoka appears and says she will "protect Kazuki's life".
translation: 一树的父母经常出国，因此他大部分时间都由远亲时泽家抚养，与时泽家的女儿叶月像亲兄妹一样长大。然而，父母长期出差期间，一树再次住进时泽家，平静的生活即将被打破。一个名叫桃香的神秘女孩突然现身，声称自己将"保护一树的生命"。
